text:
Alex: OK team, quick follow-up from the multi-region post-rfc — we need to pick a single handoff surface for resident writes. options: proxy-driven header, control-plane lease, or hybrid. thoughts?
Priya: my vote is for control-plane lease. gives us single source of truth and easier audit trails.
Mateo: +1 on control-plane but worried about latency on the read path if we consult it synchronously.
Sasha: can we do a short-lived lease cached at the edge? keep fast path local but validate async to control-plane.
Alex: that’s the hybrid I had in mind. edge uses a cached region token, control-plane is authoritative and emits revocations.
Jun: oncall concern: what happens when control-plane is unavailable? do we allow stale cached leases to keep accepting resident writes?
Priya: we should define a clear TTL and a fail-closed vs fail-open policy per customer/residency-class. default = fail-closed for regulated tenants, fail-open for low-risk.
Mateo: legal wants explicit consent headers for writes that leave region. legal-bot: Confirmed: any cross-region write requires client-supplied "x-residency-consent: yes" or an explicit company-level contract flag.
Sasha: acceptance criteria: 1) safe default for regulated tenants, 2) graceful degradation for non-regulated, 3) measurable telemetry for revocations and region-mismatch errors.
Alex: infra impacts: proxy needs to carry token + last-checked-ts in header. Control-plane needs lease API: `POST /leases/claim` `GET /leases/:tenant` `POST /leases/:tenant/revoke`. Mateo, can infra handle that scale?
Mateo: yes but we should batch revocation pushes. don’t spam every proxy on every revoke. propose topic per-region and diff updates.
Priya: UX for customers: control-plane UI + API to pin residency and to opt into safe-fallback levels. must be available in Redwood Console.
Jun: runbook question: operator should be able to force-evict a tenant from region; what happens to in-flight requests? we should drain connections and set short-lived failover marker.
Sasha: suggested sequence for eviction: 1) set tenant->evicting in control-plane, 2) push revocation diff, 3) proxies stop accepting new resident writes, 4) drain in-flight, 5) handover complete. documentable in runbook.
Mateo: metrics we need: revocation-latency, proxy-cache-hit, cross-region-write-rate, consent-missing-rate. add counters and histograms.
Alex: API backward-compat: if a client doesn't send residency header, proxy defaults to routing by tenant mapping. we should log a distinct error for consent missing so product can request consent in-app.
Priya: edge-case: mobile clients with delayed clocks might have expired tokens but real-time consent; recommend server-side grace-window of 30s for token acceptance with strict logging.
Jun: chaos scenario: control-plane partitioned for 5m, proxies should obey their last-known leases and apply local soft-throttle if revocations backlog grows. add alert `infra.control_plane.stale_leases` when revocations > threshold.
Alex: implementation plan: - week1: control-plane lease APIs + revoke topic - week2: proxy header plumbing + cache with TTL - week3: revocation broadcast + runbook - week4: Console UI and opt settings - week5: telemetry + chaos test.
Sasha: can we get a quick proto for proxy header? small snippet:```
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
X-Redwood-Lease-Expiry: 1680000000
X-Redwood-Last-Checked: 1680000000
X-Redwood-Residency-Consent: yes
```
Mateo: looks good. ensure headers are signed when coming from control-plane to proxies.
Priya: legal asks we store consent events for 7 years for some customers. add retention config per-tenant. legal-bot: noted — will follow-up with retention SLA doc.
Alex: ok, next steps: Mateo + Jun to prototype lease API, Sasha to update proxy cache, Priya to draft Console opt flow and retention. I'll write a short RFC addendum with sequence diagrams.
Mateo: ack. I'll put a spike ticket `infra/leases-prototype` and schedule a 30m sync.
Jun: will add an alert and a chaos-cases entry to the oncall runbook.
Priya: thanks — ping me when the addendum is up. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy queued: branches infra/leases-prototype -> staging (ETA 2h)
Alex: nice, closing thread — will post addendum link here when done.
